related.title: DNSSEC：簽章時間窗與信任檢查分離
related.titleEn: DNSSEC: signature time windows versus trust validation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受1232/1452 B只作此路徑的無分片上界，非所有DNS回應強制大小。 交接時須能核對：交付 edns-budget.csv、截斷／TCP重試狀態圖與逾時分類。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Treat1232/1452 B as this path’s unfragmented bounds, not mandatory sizes for all DNS replies. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver edns-budget.csv, truncation/TCP retry states and timeout classification.
related.difference: 建立RRset、key tag、signer、inception、expiration與觀測時鐘欄，不實作假簽章驗證。
related.differenceEn: Record RRset, key tag, signer, inception, expiration and observed clock without pretending to implement signature verification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
EDNS UDP payload公告是接收能力，並不保證路徑可不分片傳遞同樣大小。
教學基準：min(4096,1280-40-8) = 1232 B；對照：min(4096,1500-40-8) = 1452 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

DNSSEC驗證包含簽章、信任鏈與有效時間；通過時間檢查不足以證明真偽。
教學基準：1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s；對照：1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
An EDNS UDP-payload advertisement is receiver capability, not a guarantee of unfragmented path delivery.
Teaching baseline: min(4096,1280-40-8) = 1232 B; comparison: min(4096,1500-40-8) = 1452 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

DNSSEC validation includes cryptography, trust chains and validity time; passing the time gate alone proves no authenticity.
Teaching baseline: 1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s; comparison: 1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 逐輪記錄cwnd、ssthresh、模式與ACK條件，不把MSS數與位元組混用。
related.differenceEn: Record cwnd, ssthresh, mode and ACK assumptions per round without mixing MSS counts and bytes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

慢啟動和壅塞避免有不同增長機制；本課使用每RTT理想化模型，並非完整實作。
